prompts.label: Ideal: firm & easy to pick up

visual.shape: firm organic log shape with natural lumpy irregular edges, slightly tapered ends, NOT a perfect cylinder
visual.distinguishingFeature: holds shape firmly, can be picked up easily without leaving residue
visual.surface: smooth with slight natural sheen, organic texture with natural bumps and variation
visual.realLifeNote: Like a firm sausage with natural irregular shape - organic lumps, tapered ends, not machine-cut

prompts.prompt: Create a clean semi-realistic illustration, medical education style of dog stool for a veterinary education app. Use realistic natural earth tones, true-to-life colors. Background: plain solid light neutral gray (#F0F0F0) background, no textures or patterns. Rendering: soft shading with realistic form, gentle shadow underneath for grounding. Camera angle: slightly elevated 3/4 view, as if looking down at the ground. SHAPE: firm organic log shape with natural lumpy irregular edges, slightly tapered ends, NOT a perfect cylinder. COLOR: chocolate brown, consistent color throughout. KEY IDENTIFYING FEATURE: holds shape firmly, can be picked up easily without leaving residue. SURFACE/TEXTURE: smooth with slight natural sheen, organic texture with natural bumps and variation. REAL LIFE REFERENCE: Like a firm sausage with natural irregular shape - organic lumps, tapered ends, not machine-cut. Do NOT include: text or labels, cartoon faces or expressions, flies or insects, smell lines or stink marks, grass or outdoor environment, overly gross or disgusting details, perfect geometric shapes, sharp clean cylinder edges, machine-cut or manufactured looking shapes. This must look realistic enough that a pet owner can compare it to their dog's actual stool. The image should clearly show the distinguishing characteristics so owners know what to look for.

prompts.label: Soft but formed

visual.shape: soft organic mound losing its form, edges are mushy and rounding out, sagging and settling
visual.distinguishingFeature: still has some form but visibly soft and droopy, would leave residue if picked up
visual.surface: moist, matte finish, organic lumpy texture, edges settling and spreading
visual.realLifeNote: Like soft-serve ice cream - still has shape but soft, saggy, organic irregular form
